map.基于生活定向测验修订版(LOT-R)评估个人乐观倾向，6道核心题目(3乐观+3悲: Evaluates personal optimism based on a revised Life Orientation Test (LOT-R) with 6 core items (3 optimistic and 3 pessimistic), 1-5 points each, giving an optimism index. Pessimistic items are reverse-scored; the total runs from 6 to 30.
map.本工具基于生活定向测验修订版（LOT-R）。6 道题目按「完全不同意 → 完全同: This tool is based on the revised Life Orientation Test (LOT-R). The 6 items are self-rated on 5 levels from "strongly disagree" to "strongly agree", 1-5 points each; items 3 and 6 are pessimistic reverse items that the system flips automatically. Adding the 6 items gives a total of 6-30: higher means more optimistic, lower means more pessimistic. Everything runs in the browser and no answer is uploaded.

map.为什么第 3、6 题要反过来算: Why items 3 and 6 are scored backwards
map.第 3、6 题本身表述偏「悲观」（如「我很少期待好事发生」）。若你「同意」，说明: Items 3 and 6 are worded pessimistically (for example "I rarely expect good things to happen"). If you "agree", that actually means you are more pessimistic, so they are reverse-scored to keep the logic that a higher total means more optimistic, avoiding a contradiction.
map.有约 25% 的遗传成分，但解释风格可以调整。比如把坏事看作「暂时的、局部的」，: Roughly 25% is heritable, but explanatory style can be adjusted. For example, viewing a setback as "temporary and local" is a trainable optimism technique.
